homeTitle: Voters have the right to know the plan in advance
problem: Parties ask citizens to entrust them with a vote, yet often leave the most consequential agreements until after the election.
solution: Contract in Advance proposes one transparency standard. Every party receives the same questions about possible coalitions, the size of government, compliance with court rulings, the inquiry into 7 October, and the first steps after the election.

privacyBody:
The controller's contact details are: {{PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL}}. For privacy questions and access or correction requests, contact {{PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL}}. Deletion uses the verified email confirmation flow when an email is on file.

You do not need an account to find people or prepare a message. Personalized appeal free text is not stored. When you generate an appeal, we retain the recipient and demand selections, a public random result link, and event-level action records for 12 calendar months. The public result page discloses the selected recipient and demands and is publicly accessible to anyone who has the unguessable link; it is not confidential. If you choose an external share platform, you deal with that platform independently.

Optional reply intake stores the submitter email, response text, recipient, date, and channel, plus an optional private upload, for 12 calendar months. Uploads must not include unnecessary sensitive information or information about third parties. Audit records are retained for 12 calendar months.

If the support form is re-enabled by operators, email is required to verify that signup; name and city remain optional. That supporter data is retained for 24 calendar months after inactivity.

For security, Cloudflare may process IP address and request security signals at the edge, including for Turnstile. The application also processes IP-derived signals for rate limiting and security. The application may set security cookies needed to protect forms and sessions; these are not used for campaign profiling.

Our providers and processors include Cloudflare (Turnstile, Access, and edge services), Render (hosting), and Resend (email when configured). We do not state exact provider locations or transfers here.

Deletion affects live systems after confirmation. Hosting disk copies may persist according to provider retention. Verification links expire after 24 hours, and deletion links after 1 hour. We do not sell data or send appeals for you. Administrators access submitted data only for campaign operation and moderation.

aboutBody:
Contract in Advance is an independent civic platform concerned with the transparency of party commitments before an election.

The project is not a political party, does not field candidates, and does not recommend voting for or against any list. It puts the same core set of questions to every party, lets visitors compose and send their own messages without creating an account, and does not store personalized appeal text or link a visitor to the recipient they chose.

### Funding

As at the date of publication the project is funded by: [personal funds / funds of a registered organisation / other]. The funding source, project costs, services provided free of charge and potential conflicts of interest are published. Until separate legal and accounting arrangements are in place, the project does not accept donations for electoral activity.

### Connections

Directors and editors disclose paid work for parties, official party positions, significant services to candidates, and participation in campaign headquarters.
methodologyBody:
Public pages do not show campaign progress counters. Operators may review aggregate action records separately.

### Generated appeal

An appeal record is created when the visitor has chosen a recipient and questions and received prepared text. This does not mean it was sent. Personalized free text is not stored.

### Opening an app

Counted separately for operators: opening email; opening WhatsApp; copying text. None of these confirms delivery.

### Reported sending

This reflects a visitor's statement that they completed the sending. It is not called a "delivered appeal".

### Submitted reply

Material counts as submitted once the visitor has uploaded it. This does not mean the reply is official or accurate.

### Prohibited analytics

The platform does not publish or use a party's number of "potential voters", a user's past voting history, presumed future vote, political profile, or audiences segmented by political view.

methodologyStance:
### Reviewed public positions

A public position appears only after an administrator reviews a source, matches it to a versioned standard question, and publishes it. A moderator marking a private reply as confirmed does not publish anything. Unknown means no verified record is available here; it does not mean the person opposes the question, refused to answer, or was never asked. A party or list statement is shown as an organisational position and is never treated as an individual's answer. An older question version is labelled as historical context, not a current answer. There is no score, ranking, endorsement or colour scale. To correct a record, write to {{PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
